title: UI Push Preview
description: Computed: what a push of the source branch into the target branch would write there, and the conflicts it would hit, as the requesting user may read them, and the studio's endpoints. Read-only; nothing is written.

target.description: The branch pushed into: ?target=, else the source's parent.

changes.description: Each write of the push into the target that the user may read (its before, its after and the source's row it comes from), in the order it is made. Writes into the target only: applying the push also deletes the source's own rows.

key.description: The item's key: its name, and a stylesheet's applies_to.

before.description: The target's row the write updates or deletes; for a create, the item the target shows beneath it (its parent's or a packaged layer's); null for none.

after.description: The row as the push writes it; null for a delete.

unreadable_changes.description: How many other writes there are, on items the user may not read.

conflicts.description: The conflicts of the source against the target on items the user may read there, as a refused push (409) lists them.

unreadable_conflicts.description: How many other conflicts there are, on items the user may not read.

endpoints.description: The studio's endpoints, as UIBranchStatus has them (paths, not under the API; sample, explain and options are templates in which {slug} stands for a type's slug). null when the studio's URLs are not included.
